name: webmirror
description: Authorized static web page capture and offline replay for Chrome and Microsoft Edge.

scripts.package:windows: pnpm --filter @webmirror/helper build && powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/windows/build-sea.ps1 -PostjectPath node_modules/postject/dist/cli.js
scripts.package:release: pnpm --filter @webmirror/extension build && pnpm package:windows && powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/release/build-release.ps1
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm package:windows && pnpm --filter @webmirror/extension build && playwright test
scripts.test:e2e:native: pnpm package:windows && pnpm --filter @webmirror/extension build && playwright test tests/e2e/extension-mirror.spec.ts
scripts.verify: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
